source.rule: The installed manual says a position-linked PM may use MaterielStructure, but MaterielPM.MONIT is not allowed when MID is a materiel position.

hypothesis_before_native: The native converter should reject the position-linked MaterielPM.MONIT=Y combination with a diagnostic; no valid simulation behavior will be accepted from this source.
predeclared_native_acceptance: The input must import/export with exact authored table roundtrip under guarded session-0 SSH and preserve the GUI.
The native calculation/validation log must contain a converter rejection attributable to position-linked MONIT; an unrelated error requires exclusion or a new candidate.
A separate reviewer must read the immutable raw diagnostic and verify the one-field model delta and rejection scope.
limits: One item, one position, one PM row and one installed product version only.
A converter rejection demonstrates this input boundary, not runtime PM behavior or all position-linked PM configurations.
No GUI visual or cross-engine claim.
